Name: Kandis Krystal Meteorites for AT
Author: KandiKraze
Description:
An AT Version of my Meteorite mod! find the content patcher version here: [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/32613]Kandis Krystal Meteorites[/url] (CP)

A sparkly Crystal cluster has fallen from the sky!! Now the meteorite can be as cute as you want, as sparkly as you need, and if you like an aesthetic playthrough it might fit in well with your aesthetic!

Tired of a boring old meteor? Well, no more!! This lovely mod will (hopefully) fit your aesthetic playthrough! or even just jazz up your regular game!
